title: ProfileReport
description: Profiling report identifying CPU-heavy hotspot candidates for migration and assessing purity heuristics.

total_duration_ms.description: Total profiling session duration in milliseconds.

top.description: Number of top hotspot candidates requested/evaluated.

candidates.description: Hotspot candidates ranked by execution time.

rank.description: 1-based hotspot rank based on self or cumulative CPU time.

function_name.description: Name or identifier of the profiled function.

line.description: Line number where the function definition starts.

self_percent.description: Percentage of total time spent directly within this function.

cumulative_percent.description: Percentage of total time spent in this function and its callees.

call_count.description: Total invocation count during the profiling session.

is_pure_heuristic.description: Heuristic assessment of whether the function is side-effect-free (pure).

purity_reason.description: Explanation supporting the purity heuristic determination.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 or RFC-3339 timestamp of the profiling session.
